connector.name: Sap Adt MCP
connector.registryDescription: Give Claude live access to SAP ABAP via ADT: read, search, check, test, and edit objects.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sap-adt-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yzonur account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SAP_ADT_MCP_CONFIG
env.description: Absolute path to your config.json (host/client/user/password per SAP system). Defaults to ~/.sap-adt-mcp/config.json. See config.example.json in the repo.
